rate_limits: Account-level (rps, with documented sustained rpm where listed): Standard 1 rps; Lite/Starter 15 rps; Premium 50 rps / 1000 rpm; Business 100 rps / 1500 rpm (higher Business tiers 150 rps per pricing); Growth AutoScale 150 rps / 9000 rpm; Enterprise custom. Wallet APIs (all packages, beta): 5 rps and 75 rpm. Some heavy endpoints have lower per-API caps.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: partial—auditor wrong that Premium/Business rpm figures are invented (rate-limiting docs list Premium 50 rps/1000 rpm and Business 100 rps/1500 rpm: https://docs.birdeye.so/docs/rate-limiting); auditor right that wallet ~30 rpm is stale vs newer package notes (5 rps / 75 rpm: https://docs.birdeye.so/docs/data-accessibility-by-packages) and Business should reflect 100–150 rps (https://docs.birdeye.so/docs/pricing). Corrected string keeps official rps/rpm and updates wallet + Business range.
